products.title: Handknotted Sungudi - London Pet (Brown)
products.body:
The London Pet Saree is a treasured expression of Madurai’s Kaikattu Sungudi tradition, inspired by a historic Sungudi preserved in London’s Victoria and Albert Museum.

Crafted in soft cotton, countless tiny portions of the fabric are individually tied by hand and resist-dyed to reveal Sungudi’s characteristic ring-like dots. The richly detailed border and pallu lend the saree its distinctive old-world beauty.

Lightweight, breathable and beautifully nostalgic, this is a timeless Madurai drape that carries the patience of the artisan and the legacy of a nearly forgotten craft.

products.title: Handknotted Sungudi - Rettapettu (Slate blue-grey)
products.body:
Madurai’s Kaikattu Sungudi : Crafted in soft cotton, countless tiny portions of the fabric are individually tied by hand and resist-dyed to reveal Sungudi’s characteristic ring-like dots. The richly detailed border and pallu lend the saree its distinctive old-world beauty.

Lightweight, breathable and beautifully nostalgic, this is a timeless Madurai drape that carries the patience of the artisan and the legacy of a nearly forgotten craft.
